candidates.explanation: The body of this class was not visible, so this is inferred. Both registration (create) and profile edit (update) write through the mapper's domain-to-persistence conversion. The stored last name equals the first name after both operations, so the most likely cause is that toPersistence assigns lastName from domainEntity.firstName instead of domainEntity.lastName. The DTOs, domain model and schema all define lastName correctly, so the copy is probably wrong at the mapper step.
This is the relational (TypeORM) counterpart, and it was not in the snippets. If the app uses relational persistence, the same firstName-to-lastName copy could be there. Line numbers are approximate.

fix.description: In toPersistence, set persistenceSchema.lastName = domainEntity.lastName instead of domainEntity.firstName. Check toDomain too: domainEntity.lastName should come from raw.lastName. Make the same fix in the relational mapper if it has the same error.
